summary: A campaign worker returns to the legislative office because the chamber is still sitting.
realLife: Vogelsinger went back to Washington after West Virginia to work on legislation.
gates: The staffer has a legislative job to return to.
inGame: needs: a worker's release from a primary assignment linked to the legislative office's calendar.

turns.what: The worker stays another day to close the field office.
turns.pulledBy: The chamber has postponed the bill and campaign receipts still need reconciling.
turns.writesBack: The worker returns to the legislative desk a day later.

turns.what: The worker goes back to the bill and leaves a colleague to finish the campaign accounts.
turns.pulledBy: The floor date holds and the accounts are still open.
turns.writesBack: Two people sign off on separate assignments.
